title: Tamarind-Paste-Makham Injera
description: A traditional Ethiopian injera dish featuring the flavors of tamarind paste and makham, served as a breakfast option.
instructions: Combine teff flour, sugar, and salt in a large bowl.
Add yeast and mix until well combined.
Gradually add water and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Cover the bowl with a cloth and let it ferment for 24 hours.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or injera pan over medium heat.
Pour a small amount of batter into the pan and spread it evenly.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, until the edges start to curl.
Flip the injera and cook for another 30 seconds.
Serve the injera warm, topped with your favorite toppings.
Beurre-monte can be served on the side for added flavor.
To make beurre-monte, whip heavy cream until it forms stiff peaks and mix with a small amount of sugar and vanilla extract.
Serve beurre-monte chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of sugar.
